name: TOWA TEI
introduction: In 1990, made his debut in U.S. as a member of "Deee-Lite". Then, changed his base to Japan and released the 1st solo album "Future Listening!". Continuing to create his music while playing as DJ, and released 3 best albums "94-14 REMIX", "94-14 COVERS" and "94-14" in 2014 to commemorate the 20th anniversary of his debut. After releasing albums, officially started his career officially with Yukihiro Takahashi, Keigo Oyamada, Yoshinori Funahara and LEO Imai as "METAFIVE" and released 2 albums. Their nation-wide tour was also a huge success.  From September 2013 to the present, directed in-store music of INTERSECT BY LEXUS - TOKYO. In 2017, supervised music of thr documentary TV program of Yayoi Kusama "My Eternal Soul" and released the 9th solo album "EMO".
